previous_attribution.observed: Zero-gap back-to-back shared-leaf misses: the third demand for leaf line 0x800A2080 is replaced by a prefetch request for the adjacent line 0x800A20C0 (source 2); the demand never issues. previous_attribution.impact: Zero-gap shared-leaf misses can stall; one idle cycle avoids it. Designer review required to decide whether this is an RTL scheduling bug or a turnover constraint; not waived.
